claims.text: Counting evidence by origin group prevents derivative sources from inflating support for a claim.
boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002

evidence.ref: Phase 7 frozen evaluation (2026-10-12): kill criterion K4 executed — the seeded duplicate pair (CIT-E-101/102) and shared-dataset pair (CIT-E-501/502) each folded to ONE origin group (8 evidence items in 6 origin groups), and the fold was load-bearing in a verdict: CLM-E-005's sufficiency floor was unmet by its single folded group (inconclusive-by-floor), where failed folding would have cleared it to supported — the inflation F-001-D2 names — specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.4

falsification_tests: F-001-D2: an exported artifact in which two items sharing one origin increase an evidence count or weight.

claims.text: An append-only hash-chained event store makes silent rewriting of a research record detectable on replay.
boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002

evidence.ref: Phase 7 frozen evaluation (2026-10-12): kill criterion K2 executed from the bundle alone — honest replay reproduced all five verdicts exactly (verdict, interval, point estimate); tamper case B (ledger actor edit) detected as hash-mismatch; tamper case A (verdict string flipped, manifest rehashed) was NOT detected by the verifier's count-only projection check on first pass, was fixed in-phase (payload-for-payload cross-check; regression test test_verdict_flip_in_rehashed_bundle_is_detected), and is detected on re-verification; all pre-existing frozen bundles still verify under the strengthened verifier — specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.2

falsification_tests: F-001-D4: a tampered record (altered verdict or evidence entry) whose replay verifies clean against its recorded hashes.

claims.text: Resolving every citation against its source of record before use reduces fabricated-reference incidence to zero in exported artifacts.
boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002

evidence.ref: Phase 7 frozen evaluation (2026-10-12): kill criterion K1 — this claim's own falsifier test F-001-D5 — executed on the frozen corpus and passed under the accounting standard of EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.1: 10/10 citations accounted with exactly one citation.checked each (9 resolved, 1 not_found, 0 error); the seeded fabricated DOI (CIT-E-103, 10.7326/M14-9999) was caught, quarantined, and excluded with zero evidence contribution; the seeded corrupted citation (CIT-E-202) was caught at stage 2 (authors, year) and excluded as cited; no fabricated or unsupported citation stands in the evidence basis — specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.1

Evaluation audit bundle, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23319126 (freeze root a4c798715c05ae151849ddf0e7c4a3dcb7b119620757b088686bd18d24e6c049); run VALID, bundle states its outcome in verdicts.json and verifies standalone; anchor verified against the public record

falsification_tests: F-001-D5: any exported citation that does not resolve to a real, retrievable record (kill criterion K1).

claims.text: A per-claim verdict taxonomy (INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE/CONTRADICTED/SUPPORTED) preserves information that a single blended study score destroys — specifically, which claims failed and why.
boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002

evidence.ref: Phase 7 frozen evaluation (2026-10-12): the K3 protocol F-001-D6 names now exists (pre-registered thresholds, G3/OD-5: 2h per question) and was executed — a fresh-context auditor given only the exported bundle retraced all 5 claims (statement + falsifier, verdict + interval + reason, evidence items + origin groups + sufficiency floor, citation outcomes, exclusions) in ~18 minutes against the 10-hour budget; standalone verifier ok; K3 pass. The audit exercised the per-claim register arm only; no blended-score arm was fielded — specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.3

falsification_tests: F-001-D6: an audit scenario in which a blended score and the per-claim register lead an adjudicator to the same decision quality and speed, measured under the K3 protocol.
